production_projection: reports per S steps = S / (theta + 128 theta p_trap) with p_trap = theta^2/(2N) = 2^-92.3 at production, i.e. ceil(S/theta) exactly; the fixture projection is the same formula with the fixture p_trap, which is why the census reports the abandon rate beside the report count
reading: with the restart the report count converges on the DP rate 1/theta, so ceil(S/theta) is confirmed rather than under-counted by path shadowing (v22 measured 53.05 against 64 because a continuing walk re-hits the same DP classes)
regime: theta = 2^3 = 8 steps against a 785-class pool (fixture trap rate ~4% per segment), so the step budget reaches the DP rate instead of being eaten by abandons -- the regime in which the report COUNT is the DP rate.  v22 never restarted, so its continuing walk re-hit the same DP classes and counted 53.05 against 64.
restart_implemented: after EVERY DP the reporting trail is replaced by a FRESH trail (fresh coins) and after EVERY abandon at the cap the state is discarded and a fresh trail started; the walk continues until the step budget is consumed (verdict 3eb6d983 item 3: reports_direct never restarted)
